answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the zephyr until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the kernel of the next round. The wander of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
